page_title: BIL 0-2 RMA | Athletic Bilbao v Real Madrid 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Jesus Gil Manzano has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' The free kick picks out Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the left post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
89' It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
89' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
87' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

84' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will replace Vinicius Junior.
80' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Rodrygo will be replaced by Joselu (Real Madrid).
79' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Rodrygo (Real Madrid) causes Unai Simon little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
76' The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
76' David Alaba (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
75' The linesman signals that Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
75' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Andriy Lunin comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
72' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
72' Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
71' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Inigo Lekue and he is replaced by Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao).
71' Substitution. Eduardo Camavinga did his best and is replaced by Toni Kroos (Real Madrid).
70' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets inside the box and tries to beat Unai Simon with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
68' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post!
67' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
67' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch for Mikel Vesga.
64' Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
62' The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
61' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andriy Lunin intercepts the ball.
60' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
58' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' The players claim that Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
55' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andriy Lunin, who smothers the ball.
54' Ath Bilbao enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
53' Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
50' Eder Militao is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid).
49' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Here is a change. Iker Muniain is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Unai Gomez as he is replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
46' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is replaced by Alex Berenguer.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Jesus Gil Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempts to find Fran Garcia, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul.
44' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game. One of the players from Ath Bilbao won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

36' 0 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! David Alaba delivers the corner, Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes into the top left corner and past the helpless goalkeeper. 0:2.
36' The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.

36' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
33' The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
28' 0 - 1 Rodrygo (Real Madrid) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
24' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.

24' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Gil Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick to Real Madrid.
21' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
21' One of the Ath Bilbao players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
16' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
13' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
12' The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
11' Ath Bilbao concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
10' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
3' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) launches a cross from the corner, but Andriy Lunin is alert to thwart the effort.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Jesus Gil Manzano is the one to supervise the game today.
